name: Wendy's Plain Baked Potato (Flesh Only)
whyItWorks: A true road trip lifesaver for IBD patients across North America! A steaming hot, oven-baked Idaho russet potato served plain with zero butter, dairy, or bacon. The fluffy interior flesh is 100% gentle starch and potassium that calms inflamed bowels.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order "One Plain Baked Potato, nothing on it." Slit open the top, scoop out the soft white potato flesh with a fork, and DISCARD the fibrous outer skin entirely.
